tasks.script:
-- Button "Draft" of card "Client"
on mouseUp
  if field "Notes" is empty then
    answer "There are no order notes to write a thank-you note about."
    exit mouseUp

  put it into field "Follow-up"
end mouseUp

Write the last result in field Follow-up.

tasks.script:
on mouseUp
  put 0 into total
  put 0 into count
  repeat for each line row in field "Scores"
    if row is not empty then
      add row to total
      add 1 to count

  end repeat

    put round(total / count, 1) into field "Average"
  end if
end mouseUp
paraphrase: Repeat for each line of field Scores, calling it row:
Write total divided by count rounded to 1 decimals in field Average.
